description: This PHP class 'Response' in the OrangeHRM system defines methods for formatting data, meta-information, relationships, and errors into JSON responses for the API version 2.
external_files: OrangeHRM Inc. (implied dependencies for the project)

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing JSON formatted responses with data, meta, and relationships for the OrangeHRM API v2.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the data property encoded in JSON format.

methods.name: formatData
methods.description: Returns a JSON object containing data, meta, and rels properties.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Static method to encode an error object or message into JSON format.
